_note: Real quotes only, from parents or teachers of ours, with written consent. The repo is public and git keeps history: put an item here only after consent, with only what may appear on the site. The original text, a screenshot of the consent and its date stay 7 years in the owner's private sheet, by ref, never here. Every parent quote shows one fixed label and the year only; no diagnosis or health detail, no digit, %, ציון, שיפור, קפיצה or מצטיין. Source is whatsapp or email (never the site form). rewarded is true for any discount, free lesson, gift or draw given for the quote, and then rewardNote says what. shortened true shows (בקיצור). A block shows only with 3 or more approved items for its audience. Field rules: README, 'Quotes and teacher cards'. Parent consent request, send as is: אפשר לפרסם באתר את מה שכתבת, כ״הורה לתלמיד בכיתות ו׳ עד ט׳״? יופיע כלשונו, ואם נקצר יסומן. לא קיבלת תמורה על כך. אפשר לבקש הסרה בכל עת.
